story_text: Yesterday, I practiced a new piano song for my school recital. I imagined myself playing it perfectly on the stage. First, I played the beginning part well, and my dog Niuniu lay under the piano and listened quietly. After that, I tried the fast part, but my fingers got confused and I made three mistakes in a row. I felt very disappointed because I wanted to play well for my mom. Instead of giving up, I asked my piano teacher for help. She let me borrow an easier version of the song to practice first. I played it again and again after dinner. Slowly, my fingers remembered where to go. Two days later, I played the whole song without a single mistake, and Niuniu wagged her tail happily!

comprehension_questions: What did Niuniu do while the child played the beginning part of the song?
What happened when the child tried to play the fast part of the song?
Why did the child feel disappointed?
Why do you think Niuniu wagged her tail at the end of the story?
speaking_questions: Have you ever felt disappointed like this when practicing piano or something else? What did you do?
If you could borrow something from a friend or teacher to help you learn, what would it be?
Does Niuniu like listening to you play piano? What does she usually do while you practice?

writing_task.prompt: Write 3 sentences about a time you practiced something and it got easier. Use past tense.
scaffold: First, I ___ (what did you try to do?)
After that, ___ (what happened next? use 'and' or 'after that')
I felt ___ because ___ (how did you feel, and why?)

parent_observation: 朗读时能否流畅读出 'instead of giving up' 和 'wagged her tail' 这类词组连读，还是逐字拼读卡顿？
复述故事时能否说出完整句子（比如 'I felt disappointed because I made mistakes'），还是只蹦单个单词？
三句话写作里是否主动用了过去时（practiced, tried, felt）和连接词（after that/because），还是又不自觉切回了现在时？
聊到弹钢琴和niuniu这个话题时，孩子的话量和表情是不是比平时更活跃？
